findings.description: The proposed end-to-end completion path is not satisfiable against the real C0 round-3 ledger as written: that round contains an eligible high matrix_pin, but it also contains a medium plan_contract finding and other medium blockers. Recording only waived_matrix_pin_high cannot both permit the lock and preserve the rule that plan_contract findings remain blocked regardless of streak.
findings.recommendation: Pin the positive completion fixture explicitly: either use a reduced/synthetic ledger with only the eligible high matrix_pin, require additional valid legacy dispositions for every other blocker, or change the C0 round-3 expectation to remain blocked on its plan_contract finding.

findings.description: The objective lists auditor prompt changes as a non-goal, but the proposed features do not require any scope guard proving the sufficiency auditor prompt, schema contract, or classifier instructions stay unchanged while adding the v1.1 policy and fixture replay.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit regression or greppable boundary test that the implementation does not modify the auditor prompt/classification surface for this feature.
